comments.text: I stopped going west to ski when snow boarders took over the hills.  Snow boarders zig zag widely down hills making people on skis dodge them which IMO is unsafe and takes the fun away.

comments.author: @williardbillmore5713
comments.text:
Ski town mega giants have become a bottomless source for law suits and even with their high dollar lawyers they are losing at an an alarming rate. The liability waiver every ski ticket  comes with isn't worth the paper it is printed on once a case goes to court and careless management and a disreguard for safety is revealed.
$king is a high risk sport and the big money the giants like Vail charge makes them a big target.
